title: SLO-backed active-passive failover run-checklist and data integrity audit
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create and validate an operational checklist and automated audit for active->passive region failovers that is explicitly tied to SLOs, circuit-breaker behavior, and load-shedding thresholds. Deliverables: a playbook-style run-checklist for on-call and SRE, automated backup/restore validation harness, and a repeatable scheduled failover rehearsal with pass/fail criteria and post-mortem template.
acceptance_criteria: Checklist covers detection, decision, switch, validation, rollback and post-mortem steps and is < 3 pages when printed
Automated backup/restore validation runs end-to-end for tokenstore and KV cache with success criteria and checksum verification
SLO-linked thresholds (latency, error-rate, availability) are used to trigger simulated decision points in the rehearsal
Circuit-breaker and load-shedding behavior observed and verified during rehearsal under controlled failure injection
A rehearsal executed with on-call, SRE, and product stakeholders and a post-mortem with action items created
steps: Draft SLO-to-decision mapping: map exact metric thresholds to human actions and automated triggers
Define safe test window and customer segments (internal beta tenants + synthetic traffic) for rehearsal
Implement backup verification script for tokenstore and model artifacts that computes checksums and retention validity
Create a restore harness that rehydrates a standby region from latest backups and runs smoke validation queries
Coordinate circuit-breaker tuning: ensure offline-error response surface is covered and fallbacks are exercised
Run controlled traffic ramp with load-shedding rules enabled to validate graceful degradation and latency SLOs
Execute failover rehearsal: perform decision, switch traffic, validate healthchecks, perform integrity audits, and exercise rollback path
Capture telemetry snapshots (traces, logs, dashboards) at each stage and store them in the rehearsal artifact folder
Run post-rehearsal retrospective within 48 hours and convert findings into tracked issues with owners
comments: 2025-06-10 - Maya Chen: Ticket created after SRE offsite. Primary goal is to reduce ambiguity in failover decisions and prove backup integrity end-to-end.
2025-06-15 - Liam O'Connell: Initial draft checklist uploaded to Confluence. Need validation from Runtime and Tokenstore owners. Adding ENG-24001 as dependency for tokenstore recovery scripts.
2025-06-20 - Priya Desai (PM): Confirmed stakeholder list and customer-facing blast radius. Recommend including a short customer comms template.
2025-06-24 - Kofi Mensah (SRE): Completed prototype restore harness that rehydrates a small dataset. Observed mismatch in KV namespaces — added verification step to checksum flow.
2025-06-28 - Security review kickoff: security_review_required flagged true. Waiting on threat modeling notes from Security team.
2025-07-01 - Liam O'Connell: Scheduled rehearsal window 2025-07-10 02:00-05:00 UTC. Added synthetic workload generator and circuit-breaker injection hooks.
risk_assessment: Data drift risk during partial restores: mitigated by checksum and sample-query validation
Customer-facing outage if rollback path fails: require dry-run of rollback on staging before rehearsal
Configuration divergence between regions: add automated config snapshot comparator
Rollback latency may exceed SLO window: add contingency to route traffic to read-only endpoints
notes_and_observations: Prototype restore highlighted a race in tokenstore snapshotting when concurrent compaction runs are active — added compaction-suspend step to checklist
Circuit-breaker injection showed that some SDK clients retry aggressively; flagged SDK teams to add backoff in next minor release
Load-shedding thresholds were conservative in the first run; adjusted to match real-world tail latencies observed in the last 30 days
next_steps: Finish security threat model and attach to Confluence page
Merge restore harness PR and add CI job to run verification nightly in staging
Run rehearsal on 2025-07-10 with defined observers and collect artifact bundle
Create follow-up stories for infra changes surfaced by rehearsal (expected ~3-5 tickets)
